correctness.rationale: For every removed neighbor subset F there is a pair of nonadjacent neighbors with unique common neighbor z; hence no other center contains F, and descending-size pairing F⊂F∪{z} is free. Survivors are precisely tetrahedron boundaries per square together with graph edges. Distinct square boundaries have disjoint edges and are primitive, allowing staged disk collapses and a null attaching map for each remaining disk. The derived mixed sphere wedge is an integral homotopy conclusion, not a finite extrapolation. Executed independent code verified 3430 graphs, 23172 free-face pairs and mod-two homology.

value.rationale: For a natural broad sparse-square class, determines exact simple-homotopy reduction, all integral homology and the kernel of graph-to-nerve inclusion. Each square has a precise twofold topological effect: one graph circle dies and one independent 2-sphere appears. Infinite families can simultaneously have arbitrarily many circles and 2-spheres.
